summary.text: Gerardo Serrano is an independent candidate for Kentucky's 5th Congressional District. A small-business owner and farmer who was born in Chicago, he has lived in the district for over 25 years and says he became active in politics after experiencing civil asset forfeiture. He previously ran in Republican primaries against Hal Rogers and campaigns as independent of both major parties, focused on constitutional rights and due process.

paragraphs.text: Says he was born in Chicago and has lived in Kentucky's 5th District for over 25 years.
Says his first job was at an A&P grocery store for about three years, and describes himself as a small-business owner and farmer.
Says he became involved in politics after experiencing civil asset forfeiture firsthand.
Ran against Hal Rogers in the Republican primary in 2020 (8.9% of the vote) and in 2022 (5.9%); Rogers won both. He is on the 2026 ballot as an independent.
